lastCompletedStory.title: Per-story token display in dashboard Stories panel

nextStoryContext: US-014 added per-story token display to the dashboard. readSnapshot (src/commands/dashboard.ts) now returns storyTokens: Record<storyId, TranscriptUsage>, built by readStoryTokens(cwd, claudeDir, stories): for each story it reads the .claude/.cam-worker-<id>.session marker via readWorkerSessionMarker, resolves the transcript via transcriptPathForSession(uuid, cwd, claudeDir), and sums usage with parseTranscriptUsage. readTranscriptTokens was generalized from (cwd, claudeDir) to (transcriptPath) so one path-based reader serves both the orchestrator transcript and per-story transcripts; the orchestrator caller resolves the path first. Dashboard.tsx StoryRow renders renderTokensLine(tokens) next to the row when present, else the exported muted STORY_TOKENS_PLACEHOLDER ('.'); StoriesSection threads storyTokens, DashboardApp passes data.storyTokens ?? {}. State is signalled by the glyph (success/current/pending), never the divider color. Remaining non-operator stories: US-015 (single-supervisor concurrency guard), US-016 (rate-limit handling via src/retry/*), US-017 (recovery runbook in docs/). US-018 requires:operator (real E2E). NOTE: this checkout has no live -L cam tmux worker pane / .claude/.cam-worker-pane, so US-014 was implemented directly in a Claude Code session (operator chose 'implement here' via /cam-next), not via a dispatched headless worker; no .cam-worker-US-014.session marker exists in this checkout.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed render() returns { lastFrame, frames, rerender, unmount, stdin } and lastFrame() returns the last rendered frame as a string. The US-014 render tests use render(React.createElement(DashboardApp, ...)) then lastFrame() for substring assertions, matching both the official API and the existing in-repo precedent in test/menu.test.ts. No correction needed.
